# Visually Hidden

Text for screen readers only, in nine declarations that all matter.

In `library/components/visually-hidden/` — copy `component.{html,css}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-visually-hidden`

## ARIA

- **a clipped announcement** — `role=status` `aria-live=polite`

**States:** clipped, focusable

## Goes wrong when

- display:none, visibility:hidden or the hidden attribute — all three leave the tree
- visibility:hidden keeping its layout box, so the labeled button is stretched by text nobody reads
- width and height at 0 rather than 1px, which can drop out of the accessibility tree
- no white-space:nowrap, so the text wraps inside 1px and is read letter by letter
- aria-label as a shorter spelling: it needs a naming role, replaces the whole name (SC 2.5.3), and is invisible to translation
- :focus instead of :focus-within on the focusable variant, when the focusable thing is inside

WCAG 1.1.1 1.3.1 2.4.4 2.5.3 4.1.2 · see also `skip-link`, `icon-button`, `status-text`
